subject: Is testing a differences in R2 between two DVs possible?

messages.author: f327563b386d9314
messages.subject: Is testing a differences in R2 between two DVs possible?
parts:
Hi everyone, 

We computed a simple SEM model with one predictor and two dependent variables. Lavaan provides for each DV an R2. Now a reviewer wants to know if the R2 difference between the two DVs is statistically significant. Is there a way to test this? 

Here is the (simplified) model:

y1 ~ x
y2 ~ x
y1 ~~ y2

R-Square:
                   Estimate
    y1            0.434
    y2            0.074

Thank you, 
Peter

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Is testing a differences in R2 between two DVs possible?
parts: you could do this with the lavaan bootstrap functionality. Build the bootstrap distribution of the R2 difference and make the inference based on the respective confidence interval
